summary: Full backend + mobile-web review of MathBlitz iteration 5 (challenges v2, home countdown, difficulty ramp). Backend pytest (14/14 passing) covers admin login, monetization GET, challenge-question list/create/update/delete, Pydantic validation for 4 options + time_limit range + correct-answer-in-options, public tier read, and Emergent Object Storage upload/download of a real PNG plus auth/content-type guards. Frontend (390x844) verified: home countdown testID home-streak-countdown reads '3 days to Quickfire · 7 to Blitz master'; challenge-3day and challenge-7day render with aria-disabled=true and swallow taps while streak<3/7; admin password login (naman14b@gmail.com / NewOwnerPass2026!) reaches Admin studio; admin-tab-challenges shows tier toggle (admin-tier-3-day/-7-day), admin-new-challenge button, and full editor (admin-challenge-prompt, admin-challenge-image, admin-challenge-option-0..3, admin-challenge-correct-* chips after typing, admin-challenge-time, admin-save-challenge). Empty save surfaces 'All 4 options are required'; four options without correct pick surfaces 'Correct answer must match one of the four options'; valid submit (2+2=?, options 3/4/5/6, correct B=4, time 10s) persists and returns row with admin-edit-challenge-* / admin-delete-challenge-*. Difficulty ramp validated at engine level: createQuestion clamps level to 0 while answeredCount<10.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses in-memory admin_sessions dict — tokens (admin + setup) reset on backend restart. Fine for preview, but persist for production.
admin_login returns 403 when password is unset vs 401 for bad credentials — leaks whether the email is the valid admin. Consider unifying to 401.
Admin.tsx is ~256 lines with three inline panels; over the 200-line readability line. Splitting ChallengePanel and MonetizationPanel into their own files would help maintenance (not a blocker).

engine.ts createQuestion forces level=0 for the first 10 answered questions but the on-screen 'LEVEL 1 · TIME PRESSURE −0s' banner shows the profile level, not the effective level. Consider mirroring the ramp in the HUD so players see the difficulty is capped for the first 10 answers.

Challenge list ordering: /api/admin/challenge-questions sorts by created_at desc while /api/challenge-questions/{tier} sorts asc — could be intentional (admin newest-first, players play in creation order) but worth confirming with product.
seed_data_creation: No seeding required — password login worked with NewOwnerPass2026! from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Test data created via API is prefixed 'TEST-' and cleaned up in test_cleanup_created; UI test created one challenge (id c-<timestamp>) and deleted it via the trash icon.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contract for challenges is stable: POST /api/admin/challenge-questions requires 4 non-empty options, correct_answer must be one of them, time_limit_seconds in [3,120]; violations return 422 (Pydantic) or 400 (correct-answer). Public GET /api/challenge-questions/{tier} returns only active tier entries. Upload endpoint returns {path, url} and the download endpoint honors the stored content-type (verified with a 1x1 PNG). Home streak progression: profile.streak drives unlock; 3-day and 7-day cards render but stay disabled — to test the unlocked flow, seed AsyncStorage key 'mathblitz.profile.v1' with streak>=3 or use publicChallengeQuestions from the API. Difficulty ramp only visible after 10 answered questions within a run; engine.ts logic verified by inspection, not a full 60s timed run.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — this iteration validates a new feature set (challenges v2 + home countdown + difficulty ramp) rather than a fix. All three requirements are implemented as specified and match the reviewer's testIDs.
